QuestInfo.name: From Grandmother's House We Go
QuestInfo.0: You slept for three days after the monster invasion. You feel all rested up, so it's time to start your hero's journey!
QuestInfo.1: With your four animal companions at your side--Lai the snow leopard, Fort the bear, Eka the hawk, and Arby the cat--you're ready to become a hero. Talk to Granny Rosanna before you go.
QuestInfo.2: With your four animal companions at your side--Lai the snow leopard, Fort the bear, Eka the hawk, and Arby the cat--you're ready to become a hero. You tear up a bit when you say bye to Granny, but that's the sacrifice you make to be a hero!

0.0: It was so amazing how I defeated those monsters! Real hero-like! But then I guess I fell asleep for three days. Even the way I sleep is legendary!
0.1: As a member of the Critter Champs, I'm obligated to go on an adventure! I've always dreamed of this day... The day I set out to begin my hero's journey!
0.2: I'm totally ready. Maple World, here I come!

yes.0: First, gotta say bye to Granny!

1.0: Welcome to Stump Town, where even the stumps are beautiful. I'm Chief Woodrock.

yes.0: I don't think we've met, but I get a really heroic vibe off of you...
